scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm -w apps/middleware run build && npm -w apps/dashboard run build && npm -w contracts run compile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm -w apps/middleware run typecheck && npm -w apps/dashboard run typecheck && npm -w contracts run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && tsx --test apps/middleware/tests/*.test.ts && npm -w apps/dashboard test && npm -w contracts test
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run demo:all
scripts.demo: npm run build:shared && tsx apps/middleware/src/paper/cli.ts run
scripts.replay: npm run build:shared && tsx apps/middleware/src/paper/cli.ts replay
